ideas.title: Where the rain goes
ideas.critique: This is the round 2 'Where the rain goes' pitch again with marbles and a top-down film added; a reworded idea is the same idea. The Wada fractal basin recolouring is striking, but it is still an ambient look change of the ground like Paths we wore, and the marble drops add only a small playable layer.

ideas.title: Lumi forgets
ideas.critique: Mapping the real 4000-letter memory limit onto a cliff where forgotten things drift off is a witty, self-referential idea about the agent itself, and friends trying to hold on gives a small payoff. It is still one more place plus a film of ghosts leaving, close to the pale-copy look of Yesterday, and 'grey ghosts' is the weak, predictable part.

ideas.title: The island weighs its words
ideas.critique: Speech turned into terrain that slowly grows is a data-to-landform mapping, the same slow persistent ground change as Paths we wore and A hill with my face, with logged talk as the input. The image of a map of its own talk is charming and the timelapse shows it, but it is a visualisation of logs, and the player does nothing.
